title: Check if Any Element Has Prime Frequency
summary: Given an integer array, determine if any element's occurrence count is a prime number.
statement: Given an integer array, determine if any element's occurrence count is a prime number. If any element's frequency is prime, return true; otherwise, return false. A prime number has exactly two distinct positive divisors: 1 and itself.
constraints: Count how often each distinct array value occurs.
Return true if at least one occurrence count is prime.
hints: Test a count for divisors only through its square root.
One is excluded; a larger count without a divisor is prime.
Return true as soon as any count passes that test.
editorial: Return true as soon as any count passes that test.

tests.explanation: Value four occurs twice, and two is prime.
Every value occurs once, so no frequency is prime.
